(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターX・Y　ポケモン竜王伝''' ''Pocket Monsters XY: The Legend of the Pokémon Dragon King'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by 石井敬士 ''Takashi Ishii''. The manga was created to promote the [[Dragon King Cup]], a Pokémon tournament that was first held during the manga's serialization; a fictionalized version of the tournament is depicted in the manga. It was first published in [[CoroCoro Comics]].

The manga follows the adventures of a Pokémon Trainer, {{OBP|Akira|LDK}}, and his {{p|Charizard}}.
